content:
maria gomez: Pushed a docs PR that bundles a few linked fixes for Dedicated capacity. Main things: a short compatibility/behavior matrix for GPU types, an examples section for autoscale edge behavior (preemption vs. eviction), and a tiny SDK snippet for setting scale policies. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/587 :eyes:

samir patel: scanning now. quick note — the SLA wording currently says 'eviction may occur' but we should call out preemption separately (preemption = instance reclaimed by provider, eviction = platform-level artifact). small wording change will reduce customer confusion.

jo parks: saw that — i can rewrite the two-sentence SLA blurb. also added an explicit example for 'reserved pool + burst' behavior under load.

jo parks: SDK snippet suggestion (Python):
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(project_id="acme")
client.update_scale_policy(pool_id="p-123", policy={
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 8,
  "cpu_target_pct": 70
})
```
keep it minimal and link to full SDK reference.

alex chen: heads up — the internal infra link in the migration guide is 404 (it pointed to old terragrunt repo). replacement: https://internal.redwood/example-provisioning (external-friendly mirror link available). i'll add the mirror link and keep the internal one for on-prem notes.

nate hall: question about the example that shows behavior when quantized models are used in Private: do we need a note about performance variance (seq-len dependent)? i can draft a short callout: "quantization may change latency distribution; benchmark on target seq length".

samir patel: +1 to that callout. also add a tiny table mapping GPU families -> expected throughput delta (ballpark numbers) so sales/support have something to quote. no exact numbers, say ranges like "~x0.8-1.2" with a big caveat.

maria gomez: docs-bot — can you run the link-check and table-of-contents job for this PR?

docs-bot: Link check: 3 broken links found (one fixed by alex). TOC build: success. Preview site: https://deploy-preview-587--docs.redwood.ai/ ✅

alex chen: pushed the mirror link and updated the migration anchor. also fixed a couple of example env var names (`REDWOOD_POOL_ID` vs `REDWOOD_POOL`).

jo parks: i've reworded SLA blurb and added the preemption vs eviction callout. kept it <2 sentences and linked to the glossary.

nate hall: added the seq-len callout and the quantization caveat. left a TODO for perf numbers — will sync with infra bench team next week.

samir patel: added the GPU-family table as a high-level note and marked numbers as "typical ranges". moved the detailed terraform snippet into an appendix.

maria gomez: this is looking good. can folks +1 the PR when you have a minute? i'd like to merge after a quick tech review so docs fixes don't drift.

jo parks: +1 :shipit:

samir patel: +1 (small nit resolved)

alex chen: +1

nate hall: +1 — will follow up with perf numbers later.

maria gomez: merging in ~30m unless someone flags anything urgent. thanks all! :coffee:
